narrative.northStar: Your direct line to a little HATCH expertise.
narrative.overview: This record covers only the Hotline product card and mobile navigation entry. The user-supplied references establish the direction; the implemented theme remains authoritative everywhere else. Warm, compact surfaces and quiet outline controls carry HATCH's existing visual identity into this activation.
keyCharacteristics: Flat blush surface with dark ink and white outlined pills.
Circular Std with a compact, weight-led hierarchy.
A single swipeable question row and restrained outline icons.

rules.name: The Inherited Palette Rule
rules.body: Apply this palette to Hotline only; preserve the surrounding theme's existing color assignments.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use weight to distinguish the card title from its supporting sentence and question actions; retain sentence case.

dos: Do inherit HATCH typography and the existing product-information width.
Do preserve one question row, touch scrolling, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the mobile menu and its footer within the viewport width.
donts: Don't promote this local palette or card geometry into a storefront redesign.
Don't convert observed card dimensions into fixed sizing or wrap question pills into multiple rows.
Don't invent a separate chat interface or new visual primitives from this activation.
